name: qkd_seq_core_st_s-c1-COMMIT
purpose: RTL-BUILD-KV/SEQ 10-18 (P3): successor cluster qkd_seq_static_s of qkd_seq_static_p WITHOUT the legacy landing faces (kvn_<q>_d out has no consumer, kvn_<q>_cr / mf_<q> in have no producer on the static KV die): logic deleted (row-credit account, posted-row timeline, KVN store, kvn pin stages, xd_sel). Bench: LOCKSTEP vs qkd_seq_static_p (always-available credit, mf 0) with the actual attention programme RTL, aq/kc/hs/tk/kst compared on every edge over 36 link-slotted layers plus a live fault phase.
